question: List all film titles.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film ORDER BY title

question: What is the total number of films in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_films FROM film

question: How many customers are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customer WHERE active = true

question: List the first and last names of all actors.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM actor ORDER BY last_name, first_name

question: Show all films with a PG rating.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG' ORDER BY title

question: Find all films that cost 0.99 to rent.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 0.99 ORDER BY title

question: How many distinct ratings exist for films?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rating) AS rating_count FROM film

question: List all category names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM category ORDER BY name

question: What is the maximum film length in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(length) AS max_length FROM film

question: What is the minimum rental rate of any film?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(rental_rate) AS min_rate FROM film

question: List all language names available in the catalog.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM language ORDER BY name

question: How many stores are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store

question: Show customer emails for customers assigned to store 1.
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE store_id = 1 ORDER BY email

question: How many staff members work in the company?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS staff_count FROM staff

question: List films with a length greater than 120 minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length > 120 ORDER BY length DESC

question: What is the average rental rate across all films?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate FROM film

question: Show the first 10 customers ordered by last name.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name LIMIT 10

question: Find the titles of all films rated R.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'R' ORDER BY title

question: List all cities in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM city ORDER BY city

question: How many countries are registered in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM country

question: What are the top 5 film categories by number of films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 actors have appeared in the most films?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the number of films per rating category.
gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY film_count DESC

question: What is the total revenue collected across all payments?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM payment

question: List the top 5 customers who have spent the most on rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many inventory copies exist for each store?
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS total_inventory FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

question: What is the average film length for each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_length DESC

question: Find the 5 most frequently rented films.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many rentals were handled by each staff member?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals_handled FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: Show total payment revenue grouped by store staff member.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: List all films along with their category name.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, c.name AS category FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY f.title LIMIT 20

question: Find customers living in Canada.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: What is the total number of rentals that have not been returned yet?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreturned_rentals FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: Show the top 3 cities with the most customers.
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city, COUNT(cu.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM city ci JOIN address a ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN customer cu ON a.address_id = cu.address_id GROUP BY ci.city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List films available in English.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id WHERE l.name = 'English' ORDER BY f.title LIMIT 20

question: Find the average payment amount per transaction.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_payment FROM payment

question: Which categories have more than 3 films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(fc.film_id) > 3 ORDER BY film_count DESC

question: List all customers with inactive accounts.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customer WHERE active = false

question: What is the total amount paid by customer ID 1?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_paid FROM payment WHERE customer_id = 1

question: Show the distribution of films by release year.
gold_sql: SELECT release_year, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY release_year ORDER BY release_year

question: Which customers have made more than 5 rentals?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) > 5 ORDER BY rental_count DESC

question: List films that feature actor with first name Penelope and last name Guiness.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'Penelope' AND a.last_name = 'Guiness' ORDER BY f.title

question: What is the total number of distinct films rented so far?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS distinct_rented_films FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id

question: List all actors who have acted in Action movies.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film_category fc ON fa.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Action' ORDER BY a.last_name

question: Show the total inventory count per film category.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS inventory_count FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN inventory i ON fc.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY inventory_count DESC

question: Find the 5 shortest films in the catalogue.
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL ORDER BY length ASC LIMIT 5

question: Calculate total rental revenue by film rating.
gold_sql: SELECT f.rating, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY f.rating ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

question: List all staff members and the city they work in.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, ci.city FROM staff s JOIN store st ON s.store_id = st.store_id JOIN address a ON st.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id

question: What is the highest payment amount ever made?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_payment FROM payment

question: Count how many distinct customers rented films in 2005.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_renters_2005 FROM rental WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rental_date) = 2005

question: Which films have never been rented?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) ORDER BY f.title

question: Which customers have rented films but never made any payments?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: Find all films whose rental rate is higher than the average rental rate of all films.
gold_sql: SELECT title, rental_rate FROM film WHERE rental_rate > (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) FROM film) ORDER BY rental_rate DESC

question: What is the monthly rental count trend over time?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', rental_date) AS rental_month, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY rental_month ORDER BY rental_month

question: Find the customer who generated the highest total payment in each store.
gold_sql: WITH customer_store_spend AS (SELECT c.store_id, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.store_id ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.store_id, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) SELECT store_id, first_name, last_name, total_spent FROM customer_store_spend WHERE rank = 1

question: Which actors have never appeared in any film in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_actor fa WHERE fa.actor_id = a.actor_id)

question: What is the percentage of rentals that have been returned on time vs unreturned?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN return_date IS NULL THEN 'Unreturned' ELSE 'Returned' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental), 2) AS percentage FROM rental GROUP BY CASE WHEN return_date IS NULL THEN 'Unreturned' ELSE 'Returned' END

question: List the top 3 revenue-generating film categories along with their total revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN inventory i ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find films that are available in store 1 but not in store 2.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE i.store_id = 1 AND f.film_id NOT IN (SELECT i2.film_id FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.store_id = 2) ORDER BY f.title

question: Calculate the cumulative revenue generated by day.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(payment_date) AS day, SUM(amount) AS daily_revenue, SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(payment_date)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM payment GROUP BY DATE(payment_date) ORDER BY day

question: Find the average rental duration in days for each film category.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_duration_days FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN inventory i ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_duration_days DESC

question: List customers who have rented films in more than 2 distinct categories.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.first_name, cu.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fc.category_id) AS category_count FROM customer cu JOIN rental r ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.first_name, cu.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fc.category_id) > 2 ORDER BY category_count DESC

question: Find all films that share the exact same rental rate and length as Alien Center.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, f.rental_rate, f.length FROM film f WHERE (f.rental_rate, f.length) = (SELECT rental_rate, length FROM film WHERE title = 'Alien Center') AND f.title <> 'Alien Center'

question: Identify any customers whose total payment exceeds 50 dollars.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 50 ORDER BY total DESC

question: Rank all film categories by total rental count using a window function.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.rental_id) DESC) AS rank FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN inventory i ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rank

question: What is the ratio of active customers to total customers per store?
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS active_ratio FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

question: Which films have more than 2 copies in stock at store 1?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE i.store_id = 1 GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING COUNT(i.inventory_id) > 2 ORDER BY copy_count DESC

question: Find the customer who made the single largest payment transaction.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.amount, p.payment_date FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE p.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM payment) LIMIT 1

question: Find films rented in July 2005.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date >= '2005-07-01' AND r.rental_date < '2005-08-01' ORDER BY f.title LIMIT 20

question: Show the top 3 actors by total revenue generated by the films they appeared in.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Calculate the moving 7-day average of payment amounts.
gold_sql: SELECT payment_date, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY payment_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg FROM payment ORDER BY payment_date LIMIT 20

question: List pairs of actors who have appeared together in at least one film.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a1.first_name || ' ' || a1.last_name AS actor_1, a2.first_name || ' ' || a2.last_name AS actor_2 FROM film_actor fa1 JOIN film_actor fa2 ON fa1.film_id = fa2.film_id AND fa1.actor_id < fa2.actor_id JOIN actor a1 ON fa1.actor_id = a1.actor_id JOIN actor a2 ON fa2.actor_id = a2.actor_id LIMIT 10

question: Find all films whose length is greater than the average length of films in the same category.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, f.length, c.name AS category FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.length > (SELECT AVG(f2.length) FROM film f2 JOIN film_category fc2 ON f2.film_id = fc2.film_id WHERE fc2.category_id = fc.category_id) ORDER BY c.name, f.length DESC

question: What is the distribution of rentals by day of the week?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM rental_date) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

question: Find customers who have never rented an R-rated movie.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND f.rating = 'R') ORDER BY c.last_name LIMIT 10

question: Count how many films have more than 3 actors credited.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS films_with_many_actors FROM (SELECT film_id FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id HAVING COUNT(actor_id) > 3) sub

question: Find the store manager name and address for store 1.
gold_sql: SELECT st.store_id, sf.first_name, sf.last_name, a.address, ci.city FROM store st JOIN staff sf ON st.manager_staff_id = sf.staff_id JOIN address a ON sf.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id WHERE st.store_id = 1

question: Identify the month with the highest rental revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM payment p GROUP BY payment_month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the top film in each category by rental rate.
gold_sql: WITH ranked_films AS (SELECT c.name AS category, f.title, f.rental_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY f.rental_rate DESC) AS rn FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id) SELECT category, title, rental_rate FROM ranked_films WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category
